screen.offline.text: No signal. Everything still works; messages wait until signal returns.

screen.working.text: Reading the feedback on this phone...

screen.clock_suspect.text: The phone clock looks wrong. Nothing can be approved, stopped or sent until it is fixed.

card.mentions.text: {count} comments mention this (a review copied word for word to two sites counts once)

finding.uncertain.text: Not sure. Ask a person before deciding.

finding.not_enough.text: Not enough feedback to conclude (fewer than three comments).

finding.missing_fact.text: This is not in your farm sheet. I will not guess it.

preview.waits_for_signal.text: It waits for signal before sending.

preview.unreviewed.text: Not yet checked by a Swahili speaker.

preview.simulated.text: TEST ONLY. Will not reach a real person.

approval.confirm.text: Noor, send exactly this message? Only Noor should press Yes. You can still stop it before it leaves the phone.

approval.owner_unlock.text: Approval is turned off on this phone. Only Noor's phone can approve.

approval.stale.text: This card changed. Please look at it again before deciding.

state.business.expired.text: Too late, it will not be sent

state.business.cancelled.text: Your farm details changed. See the new suggestion.

state.transport.queued.text: Waiting for signal, not sent yet

state.transport.send_unknown.text: Not sure if it was sent

state.transport.send_unknown.note.text: Do not send it again. Ask the visitor or a person who can check.

state.special.cancel_after_acceptance.text: Already sent. It cannot be called back.

template.ask_which_direction_step.text: Thank you for visiting us. Which part of the directions was hard?

template.thanks_polite_disagree.text: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry it was not as you hoped.

template.thanks_positive.text: Thank you for your kind words. You are welcome back any time.

w2.confidence_low.text: I am not sure I understood.

w2.reply_meaning.text: What the reply says, in Swahili

w2.no_draft.text: I will not draft a reply. Here is the message; tell me what to answer.

a11y.hint.approve.text: Shows the message one more time and asks you to confirm.

a11y.hint.ask_someone.text: Keeps this card open so you can ask a person first.

a11y.hint.view_evidence.text: Shows the exact words visitors wrote.

a11y.hint.revoke.text: Asks you to confirm. Stops the message if it has not left the phone yet.

finding.model_label_unverified.text: Suggested by the phone's AI, not checked. Read the quotes before deciding.

action.revoke.may_be_sent.text: It may already have left. Stopping prevents new attempts but cannot call it back.

state.business.revoked.note.text: If the network confirms it was sent before you stopped it, that will show here.
